create_clip_frustum: create a ClipFrustum object with left, right, top, bottom, znear, zfar clipping planes
create_clipped_faces: create a ClippedFaces object to store clipped mesh face vertices and conversion tensors
clip_faces_to_frustum: clip mesh face vertices to a view frustum using clip_faces and return a ClippedFaces object
convert_clipped_rasterization_to_origina: convert clipped rasterization pix_to_face and barycentric coordinates back to original unclipped mesh faces
get_culled_faces: find all mesh faces fully outside the view frustum using _get_culled_faces for culling
